import 'package:conflux/conflux.dart';

Future<void> main() async {
  final program = Effect.build<String, String>(($) async {
    final value = await $(Effect.succeed<int, String>(42));
    final nullable = $.sync<String?>(const Success(null));
    return '$value:$nullable';
  });

  final exit = await Runtime().run(program);
  if (exit case Succeeded<String, String>(value: final value)) {
    if (value != '42:null') throw StateError('Unexpected value: $value');
  } else {
    throw StateError('Unexpected exit: $exit');
  }

  final Effect<int, _BaseError> widened = Effect.fail<int, _SpecificError>(
    const _SpecificError(),
  );
  final Effect<Result<int, _BaseError>, _BaseError> captured = widened.result();
  final recovered = widened.catchError(
    (_) => Effect.succeed<int, _BaseError>(1),
  );
  final capturedExit = await Runtime().run(captured);
  final widenedExit = await Runtime().run(recovered);
  if (capturedExit is! Succeeded<Result<int, _BaseError>, _BaseError>) {
    throw StateError('Expected a captured result.');
  }
  if (widenedExit is! Succeeded<int, _BaseError>) {
    throw StateError('Expected widened recovery to succeed.');
  }
}

sealed class _BaseError {
  const _BaseError();
}

final class _SpecificError extends _BaseError {
  const _SpecificError();
}
